name: Gatehouse Gates
slug: Reality-manifested gates that can expose the gatehouse to destination hazards
description: Gatehouse Gates are gates that can be opened by manipulating a door-like interface that materializes as a manifestation of the surrounding reality rather than a permanent physical door. Opening a gate can expose the gatehouse to environmental hazards from the destination.

log.summary: The gates were noted to have a temporary, reality-manifested door interface. Opening one can let hazards such as water, steam, heat, or other substances enter the gatehouse. In combat, opening or closing a gate takes an action, and a gate opened from a gatehouse is effectively one-way until it is closed from the originating side.
notes: The gates can be opened by manipulating a door-like interface that materializes as a manifestation of the surrounding reality rather than a permanent physical door.
Opening a gate can expose the gatehouse to environmental hazards from the destination, such as water, steam, heat, or other substances.
Opening and closing a gate takes an action in combat.
A gate opened from a gatehouse is effectively one-way until it is closed from the originating side.
